Container.Name: pubchem-local
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted, offline copy of the PubChem chemistry database with a web UI and a REST API. Search by name, CAS number, formula, SMILES, InChIKey or CID; view structures, computed properties, experimental physical properties (boiling point, melting point, density, flash point) and GHS safety data. Other apps on your network can query it through the documented REST API at /docs.
After the first start, open the Web UI and go to "Databases" to download and build the data. The lab safety dataset (~0.5 GB) builds in minutes; the full compound database needs ~110 GB of downloads, ~70-100 GB of disk and several hours. Put the data path on a dedicated share whose primary storage is your SSD cache pool.

Config.Name: Web UI / API port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI and REST API

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Databases, downloads and logs. Use a dedicated share (e.g. pubchem-local) with primary storage on your SSD cache pool. Needs ~2 GB for lab data, ~22 GB more for names, and ~70-100 GB more for all compounds (+ ~15 GB temporary while building).

Config.Name: Auto build
Config.Description: Datasets to build automatically on first start if missing: lcss, names, compounds or all (comma separated). Leave empty to start builds from the web UI.

Config.Name: Parser workers
Config.Description: Number of parallel processes used to parse the PubChem SDF files (default: CPU cores - 1, max 8).

Config.Name: Keep SDF files
Config.Description: Keep the ~110 GB of downloaded SDF files after they were imported (only needed to rebuild with a different layout).

Config.Name: Admin token
Config.Description: If set, starting/cancelling builds requires this token. Searching is always open.

Config.Name: CORS origins
Config.Description: Comma separated list of web origins allowed to call the API from a browser (* = any).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as
